name: Sticky rice with squid cake
summary: Xôi chả mực is plain sticky rice with the fried squid cake.
origin: Hạ Long, on the provincial food list beside chả mực.
howToEat: The chả mực line on Chuyên trang du lịch Quảng Ninh says you eat the cake with xôi trắng. This name is that plate.
where: Hạ Long, on that provincial list. Chuyên trang du lịch Quảng Ninh also names xôi chả mực among local products at phố đi bộ Bài Thơ.
seoTitle: Xoi cha muc — sticky rice and Ha Long squid cake
seoDescription: Xôi chả mực is plain sticky rice with the Hạ Long squid cake.
